key_insight: Quantum 3xplorer shows how scientist-supervised AI coding agents can build a quantum simulation engine in weeks, with plane-wave DFT as its first validation case.
engineering_relevance: Its layered architecture, schema-validated inputs and outputs, and GPU-supercomputer scaling offer a foundation for extensible, AI-ready materials modeling workflows.
method: Domain scientists define physics and validation criteria; AI agents write, test, and optimize code.
Implement plane-wave pseudopotential DFT with multiple formalisms, forces, stresses, and structural relaxation.
Separate abstract quantum concepts from numerical representations to support future extensions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports agreement with established reference implementations, faster single-core execution in representative benchmarks, and scaling across GPU-accelerated supercomputers, without quantitative details.
watch_item: Validation beyond plane-wave DFT and the generality of reported performance gains remain to be established.
paper_title: Quantum 3xplorer: AI-Native Engine for Next-Generation Quantum Materials Modeling
